generated_from: existing board evidence only; no new measurement was taken to build this board

phases: prepare: host-side embedding row, attention mask and RoPE matrix preparation
transformer: resident 24-layer decode (or position-zero prefill) handle execution
kv: packed K/V publication into the canonical resident decode cache
argmax: host-side argmax over the dense logits
method.steady_state: median over decode steps at position >= 1; position 0 runs on the prefill handle and is reported separately

scopes.gate_reported: the median scope the profile's own gate record publishes; this is the authoritative headline number
scopes.phase_breakdown: pooled per-phase medians over the runs' position >= 1 records, which for a greedy-oracle run also include teacher-forced prompt steps; the two scopes agree to better than 0.1% where both exist

method.tokens_per_second: derived as 1000 / total p50; not stored in the evidence files
method.tail_positions: the last valid position of each context is measured in its own single-step run immediately after model load, so first-step warm-up cannot be separated from the position cost; excluded from steady state

contexts.contract: uniform (decode and prefill share the compiled context)

evidence.note: phase medians and throughput are the performance block of the frozen v0.1.0 qualification record

contexts.contract: mixed prefill window (position zero on the frozen ctx1024 prefill.om)
contexts.steady_state_scope: 67 pooled steps at position >= 1 across 3 prompts (generated tokens plus teacher-forced prompt steps); 0.06% above the gate-reported scope

position_zero_ms.note: position zero is ~43 ms faster than a steady decode step, entirely in the transformer phase, because the inherited ctx1024 prefill handle attends over a 1024-entry window instead of 4096

tail.note: single-step run after model load; head and argmax are unchanged, so the inflation is attention over the full window plus first-step warm-up, which the evidence cannot separate

files.provides: steady-state and position-zero phase records over 3 prompts / 48 generated tokens

contexts.contract: mixed prefill window (position zero on the frozen ctx1024 prefill.om)
contexts.runtime_mode: resident packed K/V, zero-once v2_352 executor candidate

gate_reported.scope: 16-token cache-policy A/B run of the adopted zero-once candidate

contexts.steady_state_scope: 16 steps at position >= 1 of the adopted-mode A/B run; the 48-token resident oracle of the same mode is slightly faster at 165.661 ms / 6.036 tok/s

position_zero_ms.note: the ~86 ms transformer time matches ctx4096 exactly, confirming both contexts bootstrap on the same ctx1024-ABI prefill handle; the head skip removes head and argmax entirely on non-terminal teacher-forced prompt positions

tail.note: same caveat as ctx4096; attention spans the full 8192-entry window

files.provides: adopted-mode steady-state and position-zero phase records
pooled 3-prompt oracle timing for the adopted mode

executor_mode_ab.workload: one 2-token prompt, 16 generated tokens, identical token ids across every mode
executor_mode_ab.token_identity: all five modes produced byte-identical position-1 raw outputs and the same 16 generated token ids, so this table compares cost only

modes.note: every handle memory-cached; slow legacy transformer path
uncaching speeds the transformer by 23 ms but costs 24 ms in argmax; net slowest
uncached transformer with a cached argmax handle; isolates that the nocache penalty was entirely in argmax
v2_352 zero-once executor candidate; 23.8% faster than the cached baseline
steady state is unchanged by design; the gain is at prompt positions only, where the head and argmax are skipped (109.093 -> 87.849 ms at position 0)

gate_binding.policy: a performance number is publishable only alongside the numeric gate that the same artifact passed; throughput never substitutes for a cosine or token gate

not_measured: per-layer or per-kernel NPU breakdown: only the five host-observed phases exist
KV snapshot hydration bytes and time at the tail positions: no such field is recorded
separation of first-step warm-up from tail-position cost: the tail runs execute exactly one step
ctx128: no board performance run exists
executor-mode A/B at ctx1024 or ctx4096: the five-mode comparison was run at ctx8192 only
prompts longer than the prefill window under the mixed contract: every recorded run used 2-13 token prompts
